source: ICRA'13 Sec. II-A, Fig. 1 (not present in STAR'13 or TOR'16; TOR defers to [4] for objective incompatibility)
graph: Junction L with leaves S2 (robot 2 start) and G1 (robot 1 goal); junction R with leaves S1 (robot 1 start) and G2 (robot 2 goal); L and R joined by a straight path of t unit edges and by an arc path of 1.5t unit edges (t even). The four solid segments are the unit edges S2-L, L-G1, S1-R, R-G2.
interpretation: time_optimal = lexicographic (makespan, distance) optimum; distance_optimal = lexicographic (distance, makespan) optimum
note: 'some large even number t' is stronger than needed: the claims already hold for t=2.
